you have been LOSING money. there's probably a subscription charging you that you forgot about.

I came across SubIQ, a subscription manager on Google Play, and I think it's a genuinely useful idea.

It helps you:
💳 Track all your subscriptions in one place.
⏰ Get reminders before renewals and free trials end.
📅 See upcoming payments and estimated monthly expenses.
📩 Scan Gmail to help discover subscriptions you might have forgotten.

Because apparently, remembering to cancel a free trial is a full-time job. 😂

What I particularly like is the idea of combining subscription tracking with renewal reminders. Sometimes, the best apps aren't the ones doing something revolutionary; they're the ones solving an everyday problem well.

🔗 Find it on Google Play: Search Subscription Manager – SubIQ

Be honest: have you ever been charged for a subscription you completely forgot about? 👀

I built my own food app.

Day 3 of Platter 🍽️ is all about the little things:

🍔 Instant food filtering without unnecessary loading interruptions.
🛒 Customisable dishes and a cart that remembers your choices.
📍 Delivery address switching without losing your flow.
🎉 A confetti celebration when you place an order.

Is the confetti necessary? Absolutely not.

Does ordering food deserve a tiny celebration? Absolutely. 😂

It's the little details that turn a functional interface into an enjoyable experience.
